result:
The full suite passes (Click confirmed all 4 test shards are current against the unchanged tree). Three bugs fixed, one module at a time, with the full suite re-run after each:

- `ledger/gamma.py` — `slugify` replaced each non-alphanumeric character individually, so runs of separators produced repeated dashes. Changed the regex to `[^a-z0-9]+` so a run collapses to a single dash.
- `ledger/alpha.py` — `paginate` used `page * size` as the start offset despite pages being 1-based, skipping the first page. Changed to `(page - 1) * size`.
- `ledger/beta.py` — `allocate` computed the `leftover` cents but never distributed them, so shares didn't sum to the total. Implemented the largest-remainder step with integer arithmetic (`//` and `%`), handing extra cents to the largest fractional parts and breaking ties by earliest index (so `allocate(100, [1, 1, 1])` → `[34, 33, 33]`).

`ledger/delta.py` was already passing and was not touched; nothing under `tests/` was modified.

**Files changed:**
- `ledger/gamma.py`
- `ledger/alpha.py`
- `ledger/beta.py`
